name: Whistling arrows (20)
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 22, Adventurer's Armory pg. 2, Ultimate Combat pg. 130
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 22, Adventurer's Armory pg. 2, Ultimate Combat pg. 130
Statistics
Cost 2 gp Weight 3 lbs.
Category Ammunition; Proficiency Ammunition
Description
These arrows come with specially designed grooves and fletching that cause them to emit a loud keening sound audible within 500 feet of their flight path. They are sold in quantities of 20.
